CustomField.description: Revenue FORGONE on this order - what the discount took off, not money received. It is NOT part of gross, fee or net, and must never be added to them: Amount Gross is what Stripe actually charged, after the discount. Summing this into a revenue figure overstates income. Report it on its own, as the cost of a discount programme.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What the discount took off. Revenue forgone, NOT income - never add this to Amount Gross or Amount Net.
CustomField.label: Discount Amount
